title: Rafael and the Parish
author: Yara Montrose
blurb: Sable Kavanagh, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
